title: A system defines itself at its optimal macro level

statements.text: From the system’s own perspective, causal emergence means its causal self-definition sits at the optimal macro level, where its causal interactions come into focus.

sources.locator: Discussion, Causal Exclusion and Its Implications
sources.quote: From the perspective of a system, emergence (CE > 0) implies causal “self-definition” at the optimal macro level
